title: Stiff Norm Estimates for Variable-Stepsize Peer Two-Step Methods
summary: Peer two-step methods are attractive for the numerical solution of stiff initial value problems because they combine favorable features of Runge-Kutta and multi-step methods, including high-order accuracy, strong stability properties, and the avoidance of order reduction. This paper develops rigorous norm estimates for the propagation operators of variable-stepsize diagonally-implicit $L(α)$-stable Peer methods applied to stiff semi-linear systems.
